授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本科目は、日本語を初めて学ぶ留学生向けの日本語クラスである。日常生活で使う基本的な日本語の言葉や表現を学び、実際に日常生活や研究室生活で会話できるようになることを目指す。また、日本文化・社会についての知識を得ることも目的とする。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course is an introductory Japanese class for international students who are learning Japanese for the first time.
The aim of this course is to help students develop basic Japanese skills for daily life and academic situations.
Students will also gain an understanding of Japanese culture and society.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード:
日本語、初級、会話、コミュニケーション
Japanese, survival level, zero beginner, conversation, communication
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This course is for complete beginners who have never studied Japanese before. It’s perfect for students who are interested in learning basic Japanese for everyday life and who want to connect more easily with people - for example, in their laboratories or around campus.
No previous knowledge of Japanese is required.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
By the end of this course, students will be able to:
・Understand basic Japanese structure, grammar, and vocabulary and will be able to use it in their daily life.
・Speak in Japanese about daily activities, including greetings, self-introduction, vocabulary for everyday goods, time and place, express opinions and comments using simple phrases.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Course Expectations and Grading:
Students will learn basic Japanese grammar and vocabulary.
They should come to class prepared each week.
At the end of each class, there will be a small assignment. Students are expected to complete it and submit it in the next class (via Moodle).
Grading Breakdown:
Attendance: 10%
Active Participation / Class Performance: 10%
Quizzes: 10%
Assignments: 20%
Final Test: 50%
To pass the course, students need an average score of 60 or higher.
